name: block-section-separator
use: A visible line between two parts of a page where the boundary must be seen, not guessed from spacing.
avoid: First or last on a page; between every two sections.

cases.title: A boundary between the product story and the pricing part
cases.why: Two parts of different purpose read as separate.
